```{r}
library(readxl)
library(nnet) 
library(MASS)
```


## Load dataset
```{r}
data <- read_xlsx("dataset.xlsx")
```

## Feature: Direction 

### Modeling
```{r}
data$Direction <- as.factor(data$Direction)
data$Section <- as.factor(data$Section)


direction_model <- multinom(Direction ~ ERROR, data = data)

direction_pred <- predict(direction_model, type = "probs")


direction_params <- coef(direction_model)


log_likelihood <- function(params, data) {
  model <- multinom(direction ~ error, data = data, weights = exp(params))
  return(-sum(logLik(model)))
}


laplace_approximation <- function(model, data) {
  
  params <- coef(model)
  
  hessian <- solve(vcov(model))
 
  variance <- ginv(hessian)
  
  return(list(params = params, variance = variance))
}

direction_laplace <- laplace_approximation(direction_model, data)

direction_params <- direction_laplace$params
direction_variance <- direction_laplace$variance

```
### MSE of direction

```{r}
direction_actual <- model.matrix(~ Direction - 1, data = data)
mse_direction <- -mean(rowSums(direction_actual * log(direction_pred)))


cat("MSE (direction):", mse_direction, "\n")
```

### Bias of direction
```{r}

direction_pred_class <- predict(direction_model, type = "class")


bias_direction <- mean(direction_pred_class != data$Direction)


cat("Bias (direction):", bias_direction, "\n")
```

### Confidence Intervals for 'direction'

```{r}
conf_level <- c(0.95, 0.98, 0.99)
alpha <- 1 - conf_level
params <- coef(direction_model)
se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(direction_model)))

conf_intervals <- sapply(alpha, function(a) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - a / 2)
  ci_lower <- params - z * se
  ci_upper <- params + z * se
  return(data.frame(ci_lower, ci_upper))
}, simplify = FALSE)


names(conf_intervals) <- paste(conf_level * 100, "% CI", sep = "")
conf_intervals

```

### Likelihood Ratio Test 
```{r}

direction_counts <- table(data$Direction)
prob_vector <- rep(1/4, length(direction_counts))
log_likelihood_null <- sum(dmultinom(direction_counts, prob = prob_vector, log = TRUE))

log_likelihood_alternative <- sum(logLik(direction_model))

lrt_direction <- -2 * (log_likelihood_null - log_likelihood_alternative)
p_value_lrt_direction <- pchisq(lrt_direction, df = length(coef(direction_model)), lower.tail = FALSE)

cat("Likelihood Ratio Test statistic (direction):", lrt_direction, "\n")
cat("p-value for LRT (direction):", p_value_lrt_direction, "\n")

```


### Wald Test
```{r}
wald_direction <- (params / se)^2
p_value_wald_direction <- pchisq(wald_direction, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)

cat("Wald Test statistic (direction):", sum(wald_direction), "\n")
cat("p-value for Wald Test (direction):", p_value_wald_direction, "\n")

```
### Bias Plot

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

direction_pred_df <- data.frame(actual = data$Direction, predicted = direction_pred_class)

ggplot(direction_pred_df, aes(x = actual, fill = predicted)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Bias of direction", x = "True Direction", y = "Number of prediction") +
  theme_minimal()

```

## Feature: ERROR

### Modeling

```{r}
error_model <- lm(ERROR ~ Direction + Section, data = data)
summary(error_model)
```
### MSE and bias

```{r}
error_pred <- predict(error_model)
mse_error <- mean((data$ERROR - error_pred)^2)
bias_error <- mean(data$ERROR - error_pred)

cat("MSE (ERROR):", mse_error, "\n")
cat("BIAS (ERROR):", bias_error, "\n")

```
### Likelihood ratio test
```{r}

log_likelihood_null <- sum(dnorm(data$ERROR, mean(data$ERROR), sd(data$ERROR), log = TRUE))

log_likelihood_alternative <- sum(logLik(error_model))

lrt_statistic <- -2 * (log_likelihood_null - log_likelihood_alternative)
lrt_p_value <- pchisq(lrt_statistic, df = length(coef(error_model)) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE)


cat("Likelihood Ratio Test statistic (ERROR):", lrt_statistic, "\n")
cat("p-value for LRT (ERROR):", lrt_p_value, "\n")
```


### Wald test

```{r}
error_params <- coef(error_model)
error_se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(error_model)))

wald_statistic <- (error_params / error_se)^2
wald_p_value <- pchisq(wald_statistic, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)

wald_statistic
wald_p_value

```

```{r}
conf_levels <- c(0.95, 0.98, 0.99)
alpha <- 1 - conf_levels
error_params <- coef(error_model)
error_se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(error_model)))

for (a in alpha) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - a / 2)
  ci_lower <- error_params - z * error_se
  ci_upper <- error_params + z * error_se
  conf_int <- data.frame(ci_lower, ci_upper)
  
  cat("Confidence Interval for alpha =", a, "\n")
  print(conf_int)
}

```

### Plot bias

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

plot_data <- data.frame(
  index = 1:240,
  actual = data$ERROR,
  predicted = error_pred
)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = index)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual, color = "Actual")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, color = "Predicted")) +
  labs(title = "Comparison of Actual and Predicted Values of Error",
       x = "Index",
       y = "Error",
       color = "Legend") +
  theme_minimal()
```
